purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded public-service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The municipal Guía Urbana page loaded (HTTP 200); its actual catalogue lists basemaps, UV/manzano labels, districts/administrative divisions, transport, services, and facilities but no parcel/cadastral layer. The page JavaScript (HTTP 200) exposes only thematic APIs for health, education, culture, sports, security, infrastructure, and routes; no parcel/predio/lote route was present. The separate municipal cadastre page lists administrative services but no map endpoint. Thus no parcel candidate was advertised for a bounded query. Remaining uncertainty: whether a distinct municipal cadastre/tax system outside these inspected pages exposes geometry.
